# Nox API

NoxConnect provides one organization-level API for connecting GitHub and Slack and configuring Nox service delivery.

- [Machine-readable API description](/openapi.json)
- [Agent setup guide](/docs/ai-setup.md)
- [Resumable setup state](/api/integrations/setup)

Authentication uses a GitHub OAuth access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` plus the GitHub organization login in `X-Org`. Setup mutations require an organization admin.

An agent may initiate GitHub or Slack OAuth. The returned `userAction.url` must be opened by a human in a browser; poll `/api/integrations/setup` after approval. All channel discovery, organization routing, project/repository routing, verification, and disconnect operations are API-callable. Discover shared project routing at `/api/projects/routing`.
